Write down every expense for a week. Small purchases are easier to manage when you can see them together.
Before buying something optional, pause and ask whether you will still want it next week.
Try saving a small amount as soon as money comes in, even if you start with just a little.
Give your money a simple plan before the month begins, then adjust when real life happens.
Compare the full cost of a purchase, including transport or delivery, before deciding it is a bargain.
